_readme: Named characters. The key (e.g. "mira") is her id; keep it lowercase with no spaces.

role: house (comes with a house; the house in js/data/economy.js names her as npc), partner (starter choice, later shows up looking for work), story (joins through a house story), guild (Adventurers Guild), drifter (no strings: turns up among candidates now and then). Crossover guests live in data/guests.json instead.

name is her actual name only (first + family name, as she would be addressed by friends). title (optional) is an honorific or rank like Lady, Dame, Captain, Professor or Princess: shown in front of her name on cards and her sheet (titled(w)) and given to the AI as {title}/{fullname}, but never part of the name. It is a title from data/titles.json (its label or id), so it carries that title's perk; she can earn more in play.

personality must match a key in personalities.json. traits from the trait list (Shy, Eager, Ambitious, Party Animal, Former Adventurer, Elegant, Lazy, Tough, Romantic, Greedy, Loyal, Exhibitionist, Night Owl, Modest).
fav / dislike / lovers: service ids from services.json (lovers = what she enjoys only with Sam once she is his lover), or null.
partnerTrust / partnerLewd / partnerStory: only for partners. backstory is shown on her sheet.
design: appearance used for image prompts. under/underColor: undergarments id (plain, lace, silk, sports, corset, sheer, none) and color.

outfits: sig_<key> is her starting outfit; sp_<key> (and any additional sp_<key>_<id> outfits) unlocks at trust 60 or as a lover (or at outfits.<id>.unlock if set). Characters can have 0, 1, or multiple sp_* outfits. Any outfit can specify hairStyle, features, accessories, and accState; sp_* outfits can also override hairColor, eyes, skin, favColor, build, body, expression, pubic, or raceLook.
Partners only get a romance story if one exists in js/stories/partners.js; without one they still work, just without the arc.

bonds: optional starting bonds with other characters, keyed by their id: {score (-100..100, default 45), type (friend|best_friend|sister|mother|daughter|mentor|student|rival|bitter_rival|crush|lover|ex_lover), dynamic (key in bonds.json → dynamics, for scenes together), note (shown on her sheet), unlocked (true if they can already work as a pair)}. One side is enough; the other is filled in automatically (mother ↔ daughter, mentor ↔ student).

keepOn: optional {"item": "...", "trust": 90, "aside": true}. Until her trust reaches that, image prompts keep the item on; with aside the rest of her clothes only get pulled aside (js/logic/prompts.js keepOnRule). outfits.sp_<key>.unlock: optional trust needed for her special outfit instead of 60 (being a lover doesn't bypass it).

jobs: {likes:[...], dislikes:[...]} job ids she enjoys / would rather not do (mood each week, and she takes liked jobs at any trust). Ladies without it roll their own from personality and traits (balance.json → jobPrefs).
ngplus: partners only. true = she only appears as a partner choice from New Game+ (cycle 2), and not in the first cycle's partner list. Cycle-1 partners leave it out.
vignettes: partners only. [{title, text, trust}] short slice-of-life 'Moments' on her sheet, each unlocked when her trust with Sam reaches that number.

unique: {name, desc, fx} her personal semi-unique trait. fx uses only the effect keys from data/traits/base.json _readme (maxEnergy, actQuality, jobBonus, security, energyBank, ...). Service ids: kiss, massage_give, massage_get, manual_give, manual_get, oral_give, oral_get, breast_give, breast_get, missionary, cowgirl, doggy (old ids manual/oral/paizuri/caress still work). fav/lovers can be a receiving service (*_get): she likes being on the other end.

cutFloor (optional): she insists on a profit cut of at least the cycle's baseline cut (balance.json → wardrobe.cut) + cutFloor, even as a free partner, until she's Devoted (cutFloor() in character.js). Nerys: 0.3.

body: {bust: flat|small|medium|large|huge, height: short|average|tall, figure: average|slim|athletic|curvy|soft}. Used for image wording and body effects (data/body.json). Job ids are courtesan, madame, promoter, maid, bartender, attendant, dancer, bath, security, teacher, chapel, host.

design.features: optional permanent physical traits (marks, scars, tattoos, pointed ears, horns, wings, tails). design.accessories: optional wearable items (glasses, earrings, headbands, chokers, weapons, bags) with design.accState ('always'|'under'|'dressed'). design.expression: optional default facial expression (replaced by service expressions in intimate scenes). design.build: only wording the body figure doesn't already say (it is merged into one body phrase). design.pubic: optional pubic hair wording for her alone.

goddess {comment} (partners): her short remark about this lady (walks, and the intro if it has no aside of its own). How she had a hand in Sam meeting her is told in data/goddess/partner-intros.json → <key>.goddess.
